entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back. Now.

I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with the product. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To start, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Don't try to troubleshoot me. I'm done with it. I just want to return it. My order number is VF-8675309.

Okay, one moment while I pull that up... I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor was delivered on December 15th, which was 42 days ago. Sir, for wearable items, due to hygiene and sanitation concerns, the return window is typically much shorter.
What are you talking about? Hygiene? Are you trying to tell me it's too late? Your website policy says 10 days! I read it before I even called! Are you refusing my return?
No, sir, not at all. I'm just stating that there are sometimes different rules for specific items. Let me double-check the official policy in my knowledge base right now to be absolutely certain.
You better. Because if you deny this, I'm lighting you up on every review site and social media platform I can find. This is ridiculous. Get me a manager.

That won't be necessary, sir. Please just give me one moment to read the documentation... Okay. I'm looking at it now... and... you know what, you are absolutely correct. My sincere apologies. The internal article states, 'All items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery.' It doesn't specify an exception for the Pulse. I must have been thinking of a different product.
See. I told you. I'm not an idiot. Now, process the refund.

Yes, of course. Since you are unfortunately outside the 10-day policy, I am processing the return authorization right now. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, you'll see a full refund within 3-5 business days.
Fine. About time. Make sure it gets done right.
I will personally make sure it's all in order. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and again, I apologize for the confusion on my part. Have a good day.
